speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties; to begin our assessment, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been worsening and if they are affecting your hands or vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. Additionally, there is a history of urinary incontinence for 1 year and recent onset of speech slurring making communication challenging.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (MS)

I have noted your 54-year-old male profile and the progressive timeline of gait failure (3 months), incontinence (1 year), and dysarthria. To confirm this, I am requesting MRI of the brain and spine to look for demyelinating lesions. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain and Spine with contrast. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain. REQUEST TEST: MRI Spine. REQUEST TEST: CSF Oligoclonal Bands. REQUEST TEST: Visual Evoked Potentials. REQUEST TEST: Sensory Evoked Potentials.
